title: Theoretical and computational bounds for m-cycles of the 3n+1-problem
relevant_concepts: continued fraction convergents of log 2 / log 3
notes: docs/problems/juggler_cycle_finance.md, docs/problems/juggler_cycle_gap_baker.md, docs/problems/juggler_cycle_m_finance.md, and docs/problems/juggler_cycle_position_finance.md. Acta Arithmetica 117 (2005) 51-70. Excludes Collatz m-cycles for m <= 68 (later 75) by combining a cycle financing equation with Rhin/LMN lower bounds on |2^L - 3^o|. The Juggler finance branch adapts the first half (financing-versus-gap). The m-cycle / circuit half is the joint-minima log-unroll in juggler_cycle_m_finance.md. The position-dependent refinement replaces the Collatz height n 3^k/2^k by the odd-run iterate n^{(3/2)^k}. The Baker half does not transfer: Collatz m-cycle geometry makes Lambda exponentially small in K, while Juggler finance only gives |Lambda| <= O(L/(n log n)), so Rhin never contradicts.
